about_the_game:
About This Game

Yeet Up! is an addictive, fast-paced vertical platformer where you control a spherical character armed with a grappling hook.

Your mission is to climb as high as possible through an endless world filled with challenging platforms and tricky obstacles.

Gameplay Features:

  • Intuitive Mechanics: Swing, latch, and yeet your way upwards with fluid and responsive controls. Mastering the grappling hook is key to gaining momentum and reaching new heights.

  • Endless Vertical Climbing: No two runs are the same! Procedurally generated platforms and dynamic obstacles keep the challenge fresh and your reflexes sharp.

  • Physics-Based Movement: Satisfying momentum and weight as you propel your character through the air.

  • Leaderboard Competition: Compete against players worldwide to earn the highest score and claim your spot on the global leaderboard.

  • Simple but Challenging: Easy to pick up, hard to master. Whether you’re a casual player or a competitive gamer, Yeet Up! offers a rewarding experience for all skill levels.

  • Vibrant Visual Style: Enjoy bright, colorful, and playful graphics that match the game’s energetic vibe.

  • Quick Play Sessions: Perfect for short bursts of gameplay — jump in, climb high, and beat your best score anytime you want.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 or equivalent
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Potato PC
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Average PC

short_description: Yeet Up! is a fast-paced 2D physics platformer where you control a spherical character using a grappling hook. Swing with precision, dodge tricky obstacles, and climb as high as you can to dominate the global leaderboard!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Arabic, Catalan
